verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a desktop knowledge-base app, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The "privacy-first" tagline and per-graph local-only sync choice are general privacy posture and an adjacent sync control, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
